title: Canonical unbounded proper direct-image comparison for finite coefficient extension
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism of finite type between Noetherian schemes (each admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of rings satisfying the ascending chain condition on ideals) [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $\varphi:R\to A$ be a unital homomorphism of finite commutative rings. Work on the small ordinary etale sites in the entire derived categories of constant-ring module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For $T=X,Y$ write $e_T^*=A_T\otimes_{R_T}^L-$ for derived change of rings [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] and $U_T$ for exact restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Use the canonical tensor/pullback comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] and the adjunctions $f_R^{-1}\dashv Rf_{*,R}$, $f_A^{-1}\dashv Rf_{*,A}$ of [def-kun-projection-formula-map], with counits $\varepsilon_R,\varepsilon_A$. For every $L\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},R)$ define the $A$-linear comparison
$$\beta_L:e_Y^*Rf_{*,R}L\longrightarrow Rf_{*,A}e_X^*L$$
to be the adjunct of
$$f_A^{-1}e_Y^*Rf_{*,R}L\xrightarrow{\sim}e_X^*f_R^{-1}Rf_{*,R}L\xrightarrow{e_X^*\varepsilon_{R,L}}e_X^*L.$$
The canonical direct-image composition comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition] identifies $U_YRf_{*,A}$ with $Rf_{*,R}U_X$. Under this and $U_Te_T^*C\cong A_T\otimes_{R_T}^LC$, the map $U_Y\beta_L$ is exactly the ordered projection morphism
$$A_Y\otimes_R^LRf_{*,R}L\longrightarrow Rf_{*,R}(A_X\otimes_R^LL)$$
of [lem-amb-proper-coproducts-projection], including its two tensor symmetries. Consequently $\beta_L$ is an isomorphism. This is natural in $L$ and its normalization is the displayed counit transpose; no flatness of $A$ over $R$ and no boundedness of $L$ is required.
